name: MedDialBench
description: Interactive medical dialogue benchmarks have shown that LLM diagnostic accuracy degrades significantly when interacting with non-cooperative patients, yet existing approaches either apply adversarial behaviors without graded severity or case-specific grounding, or reduce patient non-cooperation to a single ungraded axis, and none analyze cross-dimension interactions. We introduce MedDialBench, a benchmark enabling controlled, dose-response characterization of how individual patient behavior dimensions affect LLM diagnostic robustness.
